name: Vault Bridge USDC

answer.rule: Safe: at least 90 % comes out even in the worst executed case; Careful: 50–90 %; Risky: below 50 %, or not everything can come out even alone. These limits are a choice, for the largest deposit in the pool.

note: Derived from results already executed or read (report, graph, history); no scenario re-executed, no existing number changed.

governance.source: read on-chain during discovery (vault timelock(), guardian())

vaultLevel.basis: executed on fork: holder value before minus after liquidations (bad debt socialised by Morpho Blue; net of lostAssets on MetaMorpho V1.1, where the share price does not drop)

concentration.thresholds: HHI ≥ 0.25 concentrated, 0.15–0.25 moderately concentrated, < 0.15 diversified (US DOJ/FTC 2010 guidelines); weights = vault supply per market, idle market (no collateral) included

utilization.watchSource: Gauntlet VaultBook (90 % utilization watch level; the 48-hour duration is not measured here)

regimes.definition: pegged: collateral of the same family as the loan asset (ETH, USD, BTC, EUR by symbol), −10 %; volatile: otherwise, −40 %
